source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("mobile phone" OR "mobile phones" OR "cell phone" OR smartphone) AND ("everyday life" OR everyday OR gender) NOT (addiction OR "problematic smartphone use")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("mobile phone" OR "mobile phones" OR "cell phone" OR smartphone) AND ("everyday life" OR everyday OR gender) NOT (addiction OR "problematic smartphone use"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("cell phone" OR "mobile phone" OR "mobile phones" OR "smartphone") AND ("everyday life" OR "everyday" OR "gender") NOT ("problematic smartphone use" OR "addiction"))
